explanation: The main character in the book, a young Jewish woman who becomes queen of Persia and saves her people from destruction.
A Jewish man and Esther's adoptive father; he exposes a conspiracy against the king and later becomes a high official.
An evil Persian nobleman who plans to destroy the Jews but is ultimately punished for his actions.
The king of Persia, who chooses Esther as his queen and supports her efforts to save the Jewish people.
A Jewish festival that celebrates victory over Haman's evil plan and the deliverance of the Jewish people.
A competition in which King Xerxes chose his new queen after his former queen Vashti had been deposed.
A period of fasting and prayer that Esther and her people observed before she went to the king to ask for protection for the Jews.
An execution device that Haman built to hang Mordecai, but which he himself ended up being hanged on.
